title: Panzer Girls
description:
Take on the role of a commander at the tank academy and lead your charming crew to defend the town against alien creatures and monster swarms.

The game features both tank driving view and strategic command view. Upgrade your chariots, strengthen characters and collect cards to face increasingly powerful enemies.

Key Features• perspectives: tank view and top-down command view

• Card upgrade system for tanks and character enhancement

• Free skill combinations with flexible tactical options

• Rich natural environments and progressive level design

• Distinctive characters and immersive storyline

• Fast-paced, relaxing gameplay for casual and strategy players
description_short: Panzer Girls is an anime-style top-down shooter mixed with tower defense strategy. Lead your tank girl team, defend against monster waves, upgrade vehicles and build your own tactics with flexible skill combos.
